name: Marund
desc: Marund in his working ironstone dome-cap, walnut mask and felt apron, lampresin windows lit.

name: Gorgewalk Mason
desc: A slate cowl bound with iron bands and rigid gorge-rope, as worn by the keepers of the Needlespan gorge. A coil of rope sits on his left shoulder.

name: Long Evening Cowl
desc: Plum lacquer and smoked-amber windows from the Serenade dusk festival, with a small lamp finial set on the cowl's flat top.
